{"test_name": "Ledger_2283_Objection1", "test_code": "using System;\nusing System.Collections.Immutable;\nusing System.IO;\nusing System.Linq;\nusing System.Threading;\nusing System.Threading.Tasks;\nusing MessagePack.SourceGenerator;\nusing MessagePack.SourceGenerator.Analyzers;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Diagnostics;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Testing;\nusing Xunit;\n\npublic class Ledger_2283_Objection1\n{\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task ClosedGenericRecordStructFromReferencedAssembly_GeneratesResolverWithoutCrashing()\n    {\n        string libSource = \"\"\"\n            using MessagePack;\n\n            namespace Lib\n            {\n                [MessagePackObject]\n                public partial record struct Item<T>([property: Key(0)] string Key);\n            }\n            \"\"\";\n\n        string appSource = \"\"\"\n            using MessagePack;\n            using Lib;\n\n            namespace App\n            {\n                [MessagePackObject]\n                public sealed partial record Cmd([property: Key(0)] string Scope)\n                {\n                    [Key(1)]\n                    public Item<int> Member { get; init; }\n                }\n            }\n            \"\"\";\n\n        await VerifyClosedGenericStructFromReferencedAssemblyAsync(libSource, appSource);\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task ClosedGenericStructWithUnkeyedPrivateFieldFromReferencedAssembly_GeneratesResolverWithoutCrashing()\n    {\n        string libSource = \"\"\"\n            using MessagePack;\n\n            namespace Lib\n            {\n                [MessagePackObject]\n                public struct StructItem<T>\n                {\n                    private int _unkeyedField;\n\n                    [Key(0)]\n                    public T Value { get; set; }\n                }\n            }\n            \"\"\";\n\n        string appSource = \"\"\"\n            using MessagePack;\n            using Lib;\n\n            namespace App\n            {\n                [MessagePackObject]\n                public partial class Container\n                {\n                    [Key(0)]\n                    public StructItem<string> Item { get; set; }\n                }\n            }\n            \"\"\";\n\n        await VerifyClosedGenericStructFromReferencedAssemblyAsync(libSource, appSource);\n    }\n\n    private static async Task VerifyClosedGenericStructFromReferencedAssemblyAsync(string libSource, string appSource)\n    {\n        ImmutableArray<MetadataReference> frameworkRefs = await ReferenceAssemblies.Net.Net80.ResolveAsync(LanguageNames.CSharp, CancellationToken.None);\n        MetadataReference[] baseReferences = frameworkRefs.Concat(ReferencesHelper.GetReferences(ReferencesSet.MessagePack)).ToArray();\n        CSharpParseOptions parseOptions = new CSharpParseOptions(LanguageVersion.Latest);\n\n        CSharpCompilation libCompilation = CSharpCompilation.Create(\n            \"Lib\",\n            new[] { CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(libSource, parseOptions) },\n            baseReferences,\n            new CSharpCompilationOptions(OutputKind.DynamicallyLinkedLibrary));\n\n        GeneratorDriver libDriver = CSharpGeneratorDriver.Create(new MessagePackGenerator().AsSourceGenerator());\n        libDriver = libDriver.RunGeneratorsAndUpdateCompilation(libCompilation, out Compilation libOutputCompilation, out ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> libGeneratorDiagnostics);\n        Assert.Empty(libGeneratorDiagnostics.Where(d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error));\n\n        using MemoryStream libStream = new MemoryStream();\n        var libEmitResult = libOutputCompilation.Emit(libStream);\n        Assert.True(libEmitResult.Success, string.Join(Environment.NewLine, libEmitResult.Diagnostics));\n\n        MetadataReference libReference = MetadataReference.CreateFromImage(libStream.ToArray());\n        MetadataReference[] appReferences = baseReferences.Concat(new[] { libReference }).ToArray();\n\n        CSharpCompilation appCompilation = CSharpCompilation.Create(\n            \"App\",\n            new[] { CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(appSource, parseOptions) },\n            appReferences,\n            new CSharpCompilationOptions(OutputKind.DynamicallyLinkedLibrary));\n\n        GeneratorDriver appDriver = CSharpGeneratorDriver.Create(new MessagePackGenerator().AsSourceGenerator());\n        appDriver = appDriver.RunGeneratorsAndUpdateCompilation(appCompilation, out Compilation appOutputCompilation, out ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> appGeneratorDiagnostics);\n        GeneratorDriverRunResult runResult = appDriver.GetRunResult();\n\n        Assert.All(runResult.Results, r => Assert.Null(r.Exception));\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(appGeneratorDiagnostics, d => d.Id == \"CS8785\" || d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error);\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(runResult.Diagnostics, d => d.Id == \"CS8785\" || d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error);\n\n        var generatedSources = runResult.Results.SelectMany(r => r.GeneratedSources).ToArray();\n        Assert.NotEmpty(generatedSources);\n        Assert.Contains(generatedSources, s => s.HintName.Contains(\"Resolver\", StringComparison.Ordinal) || s.SourceText.ToString().Contains(\"GeneratedMessagePackResolver\", StringComparison.Ordinal));\n\n        Assert.Empty(appOutputCompilation.GetDiagnostics().Where(d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error));\n\n        ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> analyzerDiagnostics = await appCompilation\n            .WithAnalyzers(ImmutableArray.Create<DiagnosticAnalyzer>(new MsgPack00xMessagePackAnalyzer()))\n            .GetAnalyzerDiagnosticsAsync();\n\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(analyzerDiagnostics, d => d.Id == \"AD0001\");\n        Assert.Empty(analyzerDiagnostics.Where(d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error));\n    }\n}\n"}
